title: Ecommerce Growth Marketing Senior Paid Media Specialist
description:
We are a DTC Growth Marketing Company focused on helping service businesses grow profitably. Our Values: - Treat others the way we want to be treated.
- Pay close attention to detail.
- Don't neglect the small things, they matter.
- Think critically and be a problem solver, not a problem creator.
- Have the confidence and determination to achieve our shared vision. Who We Are Looking For: We are looking for an ecommerce Paid Media Specialist who has experience managing large ad budgets across Meta and Google primarily. (Ideally over 1 million dollars USD per month). Additionally, if you experience using MTAs such as NorthBeam, incrementality testing tools, and MMM tools for data validation that is a major plus. The candidate selected for this role would come in and manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts for US based ecommerce brands. We have a lot of high-profile ecommerce clients that we work with and we are looking for a seasoned Paid Media Specialist who can produce high quality results for our clients. The right candidate will be task-oriented, analytical, and willing to keep the team and ad accounts on pace to make sure we are meeting or exceeding client expectations. A self-starter who can see problems and go to work fixing them and not be just an order taker. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing Facebook Ads and Google Ads for US based ecommerce brands. Must have a portfolio of work that demonstrates the results that you have been able to provide and the KPIs you have hit. Must also demonstrate your skills with creative testing through media buying on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok ads. Responsibilities Manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts of US based ecommerce brands Run ad campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok Monitor ROAS, ad budgets, revenue, and core KPIs to optimize campaigns and achieve the desired results for our clients Run profitable creative testing campaigns and identify trends to be able to communicate with the client what is working and what we should be creating more of Create performance marketing reports for the accounts that you are managing to accurately display the analytics, results, and next steps Strategize on ways to improve the overall marketing strategy for our brands to increase effectiveness Maintain awareness of current industry and technology standards, social media, competitive landscape, and market trends Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field OR 3-4 years of experience OR alternative education experience (mentors or courses) Prior experience working for an ecommerce brand or advertising agency is preferred Must be proficient in Facebook & Google Ads management for ecommerce brands Must be proficient in scaling ad budgets Strong communication, conceptual thinking, and a hunger to always provide great results for our clients Autonomous worker with an analytical mind Portfolio of work, results, or case studies You should be comfortable using some internal communication tools such as Monday.Com, Google Drive, Zoom, and Slack for team meetings and to support other team members with any technical request. Experience with Monday.Com or Asana is not required but please let us know if you have used it before or not. You should also be confident enough to push back on the leadership team and express your opinion if you think the ship is heading off course. We encourage that. Compensation: $2000 - $8000 USD per month Just as a disclaimer, please don't use AI or ChatGPT during the screening or interview process. We use a screening tool that can detect AI in your answers and during interviews. Using AI will result in your application being immediately disqualified.

title: Sap S/4hana Finance Consultant
description: Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a large-scale public sector S/4HANA transformation program for a metropolitan transit agency. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition. The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support. The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics. The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion. Duties and Responsibilities: The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction. Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations Minimum Qualifications/Experience: 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models Minimum Education: Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred). Required Certifications: Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus. Other: Experience working in distributed delivery environments, including coordination with offshore or nearshore teams (e.G., LATAM delivery centers) Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

title: Database Administrator
description: As a Database Administrator, you will responsible for end-to-end administration of Oracle 19c clustered database platforms. You will be responsible for managing all oracle databases and applications, all database objects, tuning, cloning, patching, and replication. Work Schedule: For the first six months, this role will work a standard 9:00 AM–6:00 PM BRT schedule. After the initial six-month period, the schedule will transition to 4:00 AM –1:00 PM BRT. Responsibilities: Creates and maintains all databases required for development, testing, pre-prod and production usage. Install new versions of the Oracle database in cluster and standalone environments. Plans and implements backup and recovery of the Oracle database. Plan, configure Disaster Recovery environment using Data Guard, and perform Disaster Recovery test. Controls migration of programs, database changes, reference data changes through the development life cycle Implement operational automation using Ansible and shell scripting. Perform complex performance turning and optimization for operational efficiency. Utilizing tuning utilities and reports such as AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQLT, SQL Tuning Advisor, SQL tracing and analysis, and database event tracing. Perform frequent database refreshes and migrations. Enforces and maintains database constraints to ensure integrity of the database. Administers all database objects, including tables, clusters, indexes, views, sequences, packages and procedures. Discover and implement performance and uptime improvement strategies. Assists with impact analysis of any changes made to the database objects. Leverage Oracle expertise and knowledge by providing PLSQL tuning recommendations to developers. Participate in 24/7 on-call rotation for various Production support & database maintenance activities. Qualifications: Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Information System, Computer Science or work equivalent Proven 5 to 7 years of Oracle DBA experience. A minimum of 5 years of database support and design experience and migration/upgrade experience with Oracle. 3+ years of experience administering Oracle RAC environments. Experience working with Oracle RAC cluster and 19c database, preferable with multi-tenant architecture. Work experience with installing and supporting Golden Gate, and configuring GoldenGate to be used as replication tool. Experience in installation, configuration and marinating Oracle RAC in Virtualized (VM) environment. Experience in building a DR database using DataGuard, and experience in planning and supporting Disaster Recovery testing. Working knowledge of Cloud infrastructure such as AWS Or OCI A good knowledge of LINUX and Windows operating system(s) Experience in Ansible or similar configuration management tools is desirable. Good knowledge of Oracle backup and recovery scenarios. A good knowledge & experience in using and configuring OEM Experience and knowledge in migrating code, database changes and data through the various stages of the development life cycle.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications. Key Responsibilities: Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals. Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance. Domain Tracks: You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g;
expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus. Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems. Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design. Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry. Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification. Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design. Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference. Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads. Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design. Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design. Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration. Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration. Required Qualifications: Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field. 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis). Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain. Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills. High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism. Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. description: As a Database Administrator, you will responsible for end-to-end administration of Oracle 19c clustered database platforms. You will be responsible for managing all oracle databases and applications, all database objects, tuning, cloning, patching, and replication. Work Schedule: For the first six months, this role will work a standard 9:00 AM–6:00 PM BRT schedule. After the initial six-month period, the schedule will transition to 4:00 AM –1:00 PM BRT. Install new versions of the Oracle database in cluster and standalone environments. Plans and implements backup and recovery of the Oracle database. Leverage Oracle expertise and knowledge by providing PLSQL tuning recommendations to developers. Participate in 24/7 on-call rotation for various Production support & database maintenance activities. Qualifications: Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Information System, Computer Science or work equivalent Proven 5 to 7 years of Oracle DBA experience. A minimum of 5 years of database support and design experience and migration/upgrade experience with Oracle. 3+ years of experience administering Oracle RAC environments. Experience working with Oracle RAC cluster and 19c database, preferable with multi-tenant architecture. Work experience with installing and supporting Golden Gate, and configuring GoldenGate to be used as replication tool. Experience in installation, configuration and marinating Oracle RAC in Virtualized (VM) environment. Experience in building a DR database using DataGuard, and experience in planning and supporting Disaster Recovery testing. Working knowledge of Cloud infrastructure such as AWS Or OCI A good knowledge of LINUX and Windows operating system(s) Experience in Ansible or similar configuration management tools is desirable. Good knowledge of Oracle backup and recovery scenarios. A good knowledge & experience in using and configuring OEM Experience and knowledge in migrating code, database changes and data through the various stages of the development life cycle.

description:

Com atuação em mais de 16 países, mais de 2.000 unidades, mais de 23 mil colaboradores e um ecossistema completo de marcas, impactamos milhões de pessoas todos os dias por meio de experiências que promovem saúde, movimento e qualidade de vida. Tudo isso em uma cultura de alta performance, forte, colaborativa e conectada ao nosso propósito. Nosso ecossistema reúne marcas que atuam em diferentes frentes do fitness e bem-estar: academias como Smart Fit, Bio Ritmo e Nation CT;
studios como Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, Aera Pilates, Velocity e Kore;
e produtos digitais, TotalPass e Queima Diária. Principais responsabilidades: 1. Liderança Técnica e Arquitetura Guardião da Base de Código: Definir e zelar pelos padrões de código (\ "The Rails Way\"), garantindoque a API seja sólida para os projetos Web e Mobile. Tomada de Decisão Técnica: Escolher as melhores tecnologias, bibliotecas e padrões que equilibrem rapidez de entrega com sustentabilidade futura. Apoio à Gestão: Ser o braço direito do Gerente de TI e do GP, ajudando na estimativa de prazos, viabilidade de features e priorização técnica do backlog. 2. Qualidade, Integração e Homologação Garantia de Eficiência no Processo: Homologar as integrações da API com os times de Front-end (Web e Mobile), garantindo que os contratos de dados sejam cumpridos e a performance seja máxima. Revisão de Código (Code Review): Liderar as revisões de código dos parceiros, assegurando que nenhum débito técnico crítico entre em produção. Estratégia de Testes: Definir a política de cobertura de testes e garantir que o time utilize mocks e ferramentas como VCR para manter a agilidade no desenvolvimento. 3. Sustentação, Suporte e Performance Atendimento de Chamados Nível 3: Atuar como ponto focal em problemas complexos de produção, realizando a análise de causa raiz e orientando o time na correção definitiva. Otimização Contínua: Monitorar gargalos de performance no servidor e no banco de dados, implementando melhorias proativas para suportar o crescimento do app. 4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua Radar Tecnológico: Manter o time atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, avaliando quando migrar ou adotar novas práticas. Cultura de Inovação Pragmática: Estimular o uso de ferramentas de IA para ganho de produtividade, sem abrir mão da segurança e da qualidade do código. O que buscamos Pessoas que: Dominem Arquitetura de Sistemas com Ruby on Rails: Domínio profundo de Rails em modo API e Monolitos, com habilidade para desenhar arquiteturas escaláveis, modulares e de fácil manutenção. Têm experiência com Design de APIs e Contratos: Expertise em arquitetura RESTful, versionamento e, principalmente, na definição de contratos de dados que atendam de forma eficiente Web e Mobile. Têm experiência com Engenharia de Testes Avançada: Domínio total de RSpec, incluindo estratégias complexas de mocking com VCR e WebMock, garantindo pipelines de CI/CD rápidos e determinísticos. Têm experiência com Modelagem e Performance de Dados: Maestria em PostgreSQL, otimização de queries, gestão de índices e estratégias de cache (Redis) para suportar aplicações de alta performance. Têm experiência com Segurança e Infraestrutura: Conhecimento sólido em protocolos de segurança (OAuth2, JWT), além de familiaridade com Docker e ambientes de deploy (AWS/Heroku/DigitalOcean). Adotem estrategicamente a IA: Capacidade de liderar o time no uso eficiente de ferramentas como GitHub Copilot ou Cursor para acelerar a geração de código, testes e documentação. Tenham pragmatismo e visão de Negócio: Foco em entregar a melhor solução técnica que respeite os prazos e objetivos da empresa, evitando\ "overengineering\". Tenham Liderança e Mentoria: Capacidade de elevar o nível técnico dos devs Plenos e Juniores através de Code Reviews educativos e suporte constante. Tenham Comunicação Estratégica e Proativa: Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio (GP) em tarefas técnicas e alinhar expectativas com os times de Front/Mobile para evitar bloqueios. Têm experiência com Gestão de Crises e Decisão: Calma e assertividade para tomar decisões técnicas difíceis sob pressão e resolver incidentes críticos em produção. Tenham Atitude de Dono: Comprometimento total com a qualidade do produto final, antecipando gargalos e propondo melhorias antes que se tornem problemas.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications. Key Responsibilities: Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals. Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance. Domain Tracks: You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g;
expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus. Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems. Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design. Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry. Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification. Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design. Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference. Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads. Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design. Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design. Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration. Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration. Required Qualifications: Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field. 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis). Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain. Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills. High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism. Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. title: Database Administrator
description: As a Database Administrator, you will responsible for end-to-end administration of Oracle 19c clustered database platforms. You will be responsible for managing all oracle databases and applications, all database objects, tuning, cloning, patching, and replication. Work Schedule: For the first six months, this role will work a standard 9:00 AM–6:00 PM BRT schedule. After the initial six-month period, the schedule will transition to 4:00 AM –1:00 PM BRT. Responsibilities: Creates and maintains all databases required for development, testing, pre-prod and production usage. Install new versions of the Oracle database in cluster and standalone environments. Plans and implements backup and recovery of the Oracle database. Plan, configure Disaster Recovery environment using Data Guard, and perform Disaster Recovery test. Controls migration of programs, database changes, reference data changes through the development life cycle Implement operational automation using Ansible and shell scripting. Perform complex performance turning and optimization for operational efficiency. Utilizing tuning utilities and reports such as AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQLT, SQL Tuning Advisor, SQL tracing and analysis, and database event tracing. Perform frequent database refreshes and migrations. Enforces and maintains database constraints to ensure integrity of the database. Administers all database objects, including tables, clusters, indexes, views, sequences, packages and procedures. Discover and implement performance and uptime improvement strategies. Assists with impact analysis of any changes made to the database objects. Leverage Oracle expertise and knowledge by providing PLSQL tuning recommendations to developers. Participate in 24/7 on-call rotation for various Production support & database maintenance activities. Qualifications: Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Information System, Computer Science or work equivalent Proven 5 to 7 years of Oracle DBA experience. A minimum of 5 years of database support and design experience and migration/upgrade experience with Oracle. 3+ years of experience administering Oracle RAC environments. Experience working with Oracle RAC cluster and 19c database, preferable with multi-tenant architecture. Work experience with installing and supporting Golden Gate, and configuring GoldenGate to be used as replication tool. Experience in installation, configuration and marinating Oracle RAC in Virtualized (VM) environment. Experience in building a DR database using DataGuard, and experience in planning and supporting Disaster Recovery testing. Working knowledge of Cloud infrastructure such as AWS Or OCI A good knowledge of LINUX and Windows operating system(s) Experience in Ansible or similar configuration management tools is desirable. Good knowledge of Oracle backup and recovery scenarios. A good knowledge & experience in using and configuring OEM Experience and knowledge in migrating code, database changes and data through the various stages of the development life cycle.

title: Marketing Coordinator
description: Are you ready to launch your marketing career to the next level? At Qencode, we’re not just at the cutting edge of video technology, we’re redefining it! We partner with Fortune 500 companies like NVIDIA, AWS, and Google to power the future of video. From Per-Title Encoding AI to Speech-to-Text and subtitles, we’re shipping innovations that change how the world experiences video. We’re looking for a Marketing Coordinator who’s eager to learn quickly and gain broad, hands-on experience across marketing. In this role, you’ll support senior leadership while executing a wide range of activities — from email and social to website updates, HubSpot campaigns and more. It’s an ideal opportunity for someone who wants to grow their skills fast, wear multiple hats, and learn how marketing works end-to-end in a dynamic startup environment. Your Goals Build and launch email campaigns in HubSpot (newsletters, product updates, nurture sequences). Manage and schedule social media content across LinkedIn, X, and other channels. Update and maintain website content (landing pages, blog posts, product pages). Support campaign execution for product launches, webinars, events, and content rollouts. Coordinate content and creative assets with internal stakeholders and external partners. Qualifications 2–4 years of marketing experience (internships and agency roles count). Familiarity with marketing automation tools (ie: HubSpot). Detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities. Curiosity and a growth mindset, quick learner who wants to expand your skills. Comfortable working in a fast-moving, startup environment. Benefits Learn from experienced leaders. Work directly with the founding team. Join an environment of innovation where new ideas are encouraged and rewarded. Be part of something big. Help shape how the next generation of developers build with video. Room to grow. As Qencode grows, so will your role and career path. 100% Remote position working with a global team. Professional development and career growth opportunities including an education credit. About Us Qencode is on a mission to develop cloud video APIs that democratize the latest video technology for developers around the world. Our platform combines transcoding, live streaming, storage, and global delivery in one unified API, leveraging the latest breakthroughs in artificial intelligence and video processing. A trusted technology partner to the most demanding companies (including NVIDIA, AWS, Google, and DigitalOcean), Qencode serves clients ranging from high growth startups to Fortune 500 around the world. We have several unique features, like machine-learning powered Per-Title Encoding which reduces file sizes 60% without quality loss, while supporting popular formats like HLS, MPEG-DASH, MP4 and WebM. With flexible customization and competitive pricing, we’re built for enterprise-scale deployment across any workflow. Founded in 2017, Qencode is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round. title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

description: About us: Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. title: Salesforce Crm Specialist
description: Position Overview: As the Customer Relationship Management Specialist (CRM Specialist), you will support the day-to-day execution of the CRM function. You will be a key contributor in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), partnering with Marketing, Operations, Contact Center, and Product to build and optimize journeys, automations, and campaigns that move clients from inquiry to booked appointment to loyal advocate. This role sits within the Marketing team, working alongside peers across demand generation, digital performance, brand, and content. Key Responsibilities: Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC): Support the execution and optimization of campaigns within SFMC. Collaborate on building, testing, and deploying journeys and automations with a strong focus on the end-user experience and business impact. Testing & Quality Control: Execute A/B tests on subject lines, send times, messaging, and journey logic. Document results and apply learnings to improve performance. Operational Support: Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Contact Center, and Product teams to identify and help resolve friction points in the client journey. Platform Integrations: Support the day-to-day functioning of SFMC in coordination with Salesforce CRM and other tools. Escalate issues and collaborate on solutions when needed. Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience) 3–5 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or marketing automation roles, including Salesforce Marketing Cloud Preferred Qualifications: Salesforce Marketing Cloud certification Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM Experience in multi-location services, retail, or health and wellness industries Familiarity with booking or practice management systems Experience with SMS marketing and omnichannel engagement Basic understanding of Martech integrations and data structures Experience creating or adapting content to improve engagement across the client lifecycle

- Identificar e gerenciar o escopo de testes de regressão para proteger a funcionalidade existente. Requisitos Profissional Senior, com experiência comprovada liderando iniciativas complexas de testes em sistemas de grande escala.

title: Salesforce Crm Specialist

title: Conversion Rate Optimization Manager
description:

You will oversee and execute A/B testing, user behavior analyses, funnel audits, and UX gap analyses. Prioritize experiments based on potential impact, traffic, and business goals to build a rigorous, data-driven testing roadmap. On-Site Optimization: Optimize landing pages, product detail pages (PDPs), collection pages, cart, and checkout flows to maximize conversion. Collaborate with their ecommerce and design teams to ensure all pages are aligned with CRO best practices. User Behavior Analysis: Leverage heatmaps, session recordings, funnel analytics, and user surveys to uncover friction points and opportunities. Translate qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable hypotheses. Shopify & Development Collaboration: Partner closely with their development team to implement CRO changes on the Shopify platform. Ensure experiments and site updates are implemented accurately, QA tested, and deployed efficiently. Funnel & Revenue Optimization: Identify and prioritize drop-off points across the customer journey from acquisition through post-purchase and develop initiatives to reduce abandonment, increase AOV, and improve repeat purchase rates. Reporting and Analysis: Provide regular reports on CRO performance, experiment results, and KPIs using analytics and CRO tools. Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and leadership. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. In-depth knowledge of CRO principles, UX best practices, and e-commerce conversion frameworks. Strong understanding of A/B testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design. Hands-on experience with Shopify or a comparable e-commerce platform;
ability to collaborateeffectively with development teams on implementation. Proficiency in using CRO and analytics tools such as Google Analytics, heatmap tools, and experimentation platforms. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex data sets, experiment results, and performance reports. Ability to present findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams and leadership. Ability to solve practical problems and apply structured experimentation methodology in ambiguous situations. Ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative data to form clear, testable hypotheses. Ability to calculate and interpret key metrics such as conversion rates, statistical significance, and revenue metrics. Education and/or experience Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university, or equivalent experience as a CRO specialist or analyst in e-commerce. 3–5 years of experience managing a CRO program or cross-functional optimization team. Core competencies Action Oriented: Taking on new opportunities and challenges with urgency and energy. Resourcefulness: Securing and deploying resources effectively. Collaboration: Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others. Self-Development: Actively seeking growth opportunities. Strategic Thinking: Identifying opportunities and adapting to trends. Technical Proficiency & Problem Solving: Using tools and data to drive solutions. Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills. Results-driven: Focused on measurable, data-driven outcomes. Benefits A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance. The opportunity to drive measurable revenue growth by optimizing user experience and conversion performance. Two weeks of paid vacation per year. 10 paid days for local holidays. *Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Analista De Crm Sênior
description:

Por isso, buscamos um Super Analista de CRM Sênior, que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Revenue e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente. Responsabilidades Como Analista Sênior, você será a referência técnica e estratégica do time de CRM. Apoiar o desenvolvimento do time de CRM compartilhando boas práticas. Experiência emgestão de projetos, com capacidade de estruturar e executar processos repetíveis, eficientes e escaláveis de forma colaborativa com diferentes áreas. Diferenciais Experiência em startups e/ou empresas de tecnologia;

Buscamos excelência emtudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto. O que oferecemos

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer /referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:

Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia?Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiarvalidações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas.Para esta vaga, é essencial:Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimento prático dePython para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial comDatabricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimento emGit e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidadepara atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado.Você pode se destacar se:Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade?Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

User Behavior Analysis: Leverage heatmaps, session recordings, funnel analytics, and user surveys to uncover friction points and opportunities. Ensure experiments and site updates are implemented accurately, QA tested, and deployed efficiently. Funnel & Revenue Optimization: Identify and prioritize drop-off points across the customer journey from acquisition through post-purchase and develop initiatives to reduce abandonment, increase AOV, and improve repeat purchase rates. Strong understanding of A/B testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design. Hands-on experience with Shopify or a comparable e-commerce platform;
ability to collaborateeffectively with development teams on implementation. Proficiency in using CRO and analytics tools such as Google Analytics, heatmap tools, and experimentation platforms. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex data sets, experiment results, and performance reports. Ability to present findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams and leadership. Ability to solve practical problems and apply structured experimentation methodology in ambiguous situations. Ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative data to form clear, testable hypotheses. Ability to calculate and interpret key metrics such as conversion rates, statistical significance, and revenue metrics. Education and/or experience Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university, or equivalent experience as a CRO specialist or analyst in e-commerce. 3–5 years of experience managing a CRO program or cross-functional optimization team. Core competencies Action Oriented: Taking on new opportunities and challenges with urgency and energy. Resourcefulness: Securing and deploying resources effectively. Collaboration: Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others. Self-Development: Actively seeking growth opportunities. Strategic Thinking: Identifying opportunities and adapting to trends. Technical Proficiency & Problem Solving: Using tools and data to drive solutions. Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills. Results-driven: Focused on measurable, data-driven outcomes. Benefits A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance. The opportunity to drive measurable revenue growth by optimizing user experience and conversion performance. title: Salesforce Crm Specialist
description: Position Overview: As the Customer Relationship Management Specialist (CRM Specialist), you will support the day-to-day execution of the CRM function. You will be a key contributor in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), partnering with Marketing, Operations, Contact Center, and Product to build and optimize journeys, automations, and campaigns that move clients from inquiry to booked appointment to loyal advocate. This role sits within the Marketing team, working alongside peers across demand generation, digital performance, brand, and content. Key Responsibilities: Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC): Support the execution and optimization of campaigns within SFMC. Collaborate on building, testing, and deploying journeys and automations with a strong focus on the end-user experience and business impact. Client Journey: Assist in building and improving omnichannel journeys across email and SMS, supporting key moments from lead to booking to post-visit engagement, including reminders and follow-ups. Data Segmentation and Hygiene: Maintain audience segments and support data quality initiatives, including contact organization, suppression lists, and basic scoring logic to ensure a reliable database. Testing & Quality Control: Execute A/B tests on subject lines, send times, messaging, and journey logic. Document results and apply learnings to improve performance. Performance & Reporting: Support CRM reporting by tracking key metrics such as bookings, conversion rates, and engagement. Contribute to performance analysis and insights. Operational Support: Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Contact Center, and Product teams to identify and help resolve friction points in the client journey. Platform Integrations: Support the day-to-day functioning of SFMC in coordination with Salesforce CRM and other tools. Escalate issues and collaborate on solutions when needed. Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience) 3–5 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or marketing automation roles, including Salesforce Marketing Cloud Preferred Qualifications: Salesforce Marketing Cloud certification Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM Experience in multi-location services, retail, or health and wellness industries Familiarity with booking or practice management systems Experience with SMS marketing and omnichannel engagement Basic understanding of Martech integrations and data structures Experience creating or adapting content to improve engagement across the client lifecycle

Trabalhar leads qualificados gerados pelo Marketing (inbound), com foco em conversão eficiente;

Mapear o processo decisório do cliente e influenciar cada etapa do funil;

Histórico de atuação híbrida: capacidade tanto de converter inbound quanto de gerar pipeline outbound;
Experiência com vendasconsultivas;
Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade real de se comunicar com decisores;
Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM, HubSpot é diferencial;
Ensino superior completo. Também é legal se você tiver: Vivência em ambientes de scale-up e/ou startups em crescimento acelerado ou empresas de tecnologia;
Familiaridade com HubSpot. Carteira ou relacionamento com profissionais de Comunicação e Marketing em empresas de médio/grande porte;
Experiência com ferramentas de prospecção e automação (ex: Apollo, Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator);
Conhecimento do ecossistema de agências de PR e assessorias de imprensa;
O que oferecemos: Trabalho 100% remoto - Home Office;
Política de remuneração variável agressiva - com comissionamento competitivo e upside real atrelado à sua performance;
Pacote de benefícios Knewin;
Produto consolidado com cases relevantes no mercado;
Time comercialestruturado com suporte de Marketing, RevOps e CS;
Ambiente dinâmico, flexível e com autonomia real;
Oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa em fase de expansão acelerada.

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCoNatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilitiesThe Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline managementMap priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.Eligibility, due diligence & agreementsCoordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentationLead closure of contract signatures.Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).Reforestation delivery enablementTranslate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).Stakeholder engagement and safeguardsPlan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.ReportingLead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.Teamwork and cultureSupport the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributesTo perform successfully in this role, you will have:A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skillsExcellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partnersAbility to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.LocationRemote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructionsEmail CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery ManagerSubmission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us:YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:- Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes- Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months- Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure- Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intentionIf your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.About The Role:The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs.Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:- Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.- Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.- Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.- Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.- Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.- Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.- Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.- Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.- Take ownership of The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Azure Databricks, data engineering, and cloud-native architectures, along with hands-on experience in data mesh, data products, and Unity Catalog–based governance. Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready data solutions. Identify cross-system dependencies, integration points, and architectural risks. Data Platform Design & Governance Define best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and serving within Databricks. Establish standards for data product ownership, contracts, and lifecycle management. Implement enterprise-grade security and access control using Unity Catalog, Entra ID, and cloud-native tools. Ensure alignment with enterprise governance, compliance, and security policies. Contribute to reusable architecture patterns and platform standards. Hands-on Execution & Proof-of-Concepts Design and execute POCs to validate architectural decisions and reduce delivery risk. Remain hands-on with: Python for data engineering, notebooks, and automation C# / Python for APIs, integrations, and platform services Support engineering teams by reviewing designs, resolving technical challenges, and ensuring architectural alignment. Collaboration & Delivery Alignment Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to shape features and solution direction. Collaborate with System Architects to align solution and system-level designs. Guide Agile teams through architecture decisions during planning and execution. Participate in architecture reviews and continuous improvement initiatives. Technical Leadership & Mentorship Provide guidance and mentorship to architects, tech leads, and senior engineers. Promote best practices in data architecture, engineering, and cloud platform design. Lead design reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Architecture Documentation Develop architecture artifacts including C4 models and design documentation. Create High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs), including sequence diagrams and data flows. Document functional and non-functional requirements aligned with architectural designs. Required Qualifications 7+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture roles. Proven experience designing and delivering data platforms on Azure Databricks. Strong understanding of data mesh concepts and domain-oriented data products. Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog (governance, security, lineage). Solid programming experience in Python and/or C#, including API and integration design. Experience designing end-to-end solutions across data platforms, APIs, and cloud infrastructure. Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures, DevOps practices, and operational considerations. Experience creating architectural artifacts and design documentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to operate in complex environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements. Preferred Qualifications Prior experience as a Solutions Architect, System Architect, or Senior Technical Lead. Experience working in consulting or large enterprise environments. Familiarity with Agile frameworks (e.G., SAFe) and PI Planning. Experience with diagram-as-code tools such as Structurizr, PlantUML, or Mermaid. Key Competencies Strategic thinking with a hands-on, delivery-focused mindset Strong problem-solving and analytical skills Ability to bridge business and technical stakeholders Leadership and mentorship capabilities Continuous learning and innovation mindset
